n.story:
Your profession remains one of the most resilient to the AI wave because of the sheer physical complexity of construction sites. While AI won't be installing tiles for you, it will become an invisible supervisor that keeps you safer and more efficient. Your phone or wearable device will use computer vision to instantly inspect supplies for defects and moisture as they arrive, and AR overlays will guide your measurements to ensure perfect alignment with zero waste.

The biggest change you'll notice is in the 'mental' load of the job. AI will handle the math of cutting patterns and logistics, while real-time ergonomic monitoring will alert you if you're straining your body, helping you extend your career. You remain the master of the physical environment, but you'll be supported by data that ensures every measurement is precise and every safety protocol is met without manual double-checking.

amp: Precision measurement through AR-guided tools
Real-time ergonomic health monitoring
Enhanced hazard detection via computer vision
Optimized logistics and supply transport
Automated documentation of work progress
n.adv: Focus on learning to use AR-assisted measurement and layout tools, as these will become the industry standard for precision and speed.
